name: Cairn
author: Erin Carter
description: A moor of balanced stone cairns — stacks of flattened rounded boulders, each teetering on the one below — recedes into luminous haze. Raymarched as true 3D solids so nearer stacks occlude farther ones, with exponential distance fog, a colour-2 rim where each silhouette meets the brighter haze behind it, and a sparse moss-vein of colour 3 on a hash-chosen few crowns. The camera dollies forward down a sinuous lane threaded between the cairns; the world holds perfectly still.

params.label: Dolly speed
params.effect: Forward walking speed of the camera down the lane, from a near-still drift to a steady stride.

params.label: Fog density
params.effect: How fast distance dissolves the cairns into haze — thin air reveals a deep field, dense fog closes it to a few near stacks.

params.label: Cairn spacing
params.effect: World gap between cairns, from a crowded boulder field to sparse stacks on an open moor.

params.label: Rim glow
params.effect: Strength of the bright fog-lit rim tracing each cairn's silhouette.
